title: Security Incident Management and Investigations
overview: This comprehensive 5-day course is divided into two key parts: Incident Management and Fundamentals of Investigations.

In the Incident Management section, participants will learn how incident management works and how to effectively implement and apply these principles within their organizations. The goal is to restore normal business operations—safety, productivity, and overall functionality—following an incident. Key topics include the principles of incident management, methodology, and incident typology.

In the Fundamentals of Investigations section, participants will gain hands-on experience in crime scene management, evidence collection, and conducting interviews. They will also explore techniques for preserving evidence, preparing case files, and overcoming common investigative challenges, such as interviewing suspects and ensuring legal admissibility of evidence.
audience: This course is ideal for security managers and supervisors, company investigators, HR professionals, site managers, safety and incident response team members, business owners, and anyone involved in managing security incidents and investigations.
methodology: The course combines various learning methods, including case studies, role-playing exercises, presentations, group discussions, and video analysis, to create an interactive learning environment.
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: Apply the principles of Incident Management in their workplace.
Implement Incident Management methodologies to create recovery plans for swift business resumption after incidents.
Understand and apply the fundamentals of investigations.
Conduct a basic internal investigation within their organization.
Execute a complete crime scene preservation investigation, from initial response to case conclusion.
